about.title: About Us
about.story:
Hare Krishna Krishi Tatha Pasu Panchhi Farm was established in 2020 to provide clean and reliable dairy products to our local community. We believe small farms can deliver better quality, care, and honesty than large commercial setups.

From the beginning, we have followed traditional methods, careful handling, and fixed pricing so our neighbors can trust us. Along with milk from our own cows, we also work with local farmers when needed, making sure quality checks and fair treatment are always maintained.

Our dairy operates with simple record keeping, a monthly credit system for village families, and a commitment to transparency in every transaction.
about.mission: To serve our village with fresh, pure dairy products through honest practices, traditional methods, and personal care. We aim to keep pricing fair, maintain trust with local families, and support nearby farmers whenever possible.

milkCollection.title: Milk Collection & Credit System
milkCollection.collectionDescription: In addition to milk from our own cows, we collect fresh milk from nearby farms and village households when required. All milk is checked before storage and processing.
milkCollection.creditDescription: Village customers can take milk and dairy products on monthly credit. Records are maintained manually in a notebook, ensuring transparency and mutual trust.
process: Fresh milk arrives daily from our farm and trusted local sources
Daily delivery to your doorstep or farm pickup
Monthly billing with credit option for trusted customers
Transparent record keeping in our farm notebook
